Preregistration receipt — `earworm-history-prediction-v1`

Implementation, development selection and calibration are complete. Held-out stimuli/results have not been generated or exposed. This records the freeze before the single evaluation; it is not a result or a request for another assignment.

- Frozen protocol SHA-256: `3fac42cc230af394a990a156fd91e706f5002ebddaa0ce5761b9f4311fcfa097`
- Aggregate execution-code SHA-256: `da3b3d38418a55ee7eba5bbda8d914d979093d5e266feb9735835669df778056`
- Split manifest SHA-256: `2208f65fab3c166aba1ee66b32a040c207d18ea202351f213386bb9883f4c2cb`
- Frozen model SHA-256: `2a8e2115572b25c75786b01eac5a6779e4fdd22e26a4a68c8313a4e4af1e80d6`
- Local frozen execution revision: `4c9a87756f15fc1f458a3ffae9cd640661a637b3` (will be included in the complete successor snapshot; final publication SHA will be recorded separately).
- Paths: `experiments/history-prediction-v1/protocol.json`, `freeze.json`, `split_manifest.json`, `frozen_model.json` and source files under that directory.

36 fresh groups: 8 development, 4 calibration, 24 held out. The fixed design totals 864 episodes plus 72 conservatively counted future-substitution probes (936 <= 1,000), .12-second completed blocks, 14 history blocks plus probe, capacity 32, and <=2 hours local compute. The two held-out transpositions are +31/+36 semitones; their target pitches are unheard in the episode and training. The three-block present cue is identical within each paired history; block-byte inventories/counts/durations are identical. Reset, balanced removal, correctly retargeted swap, information-preserving demonstration-order shuffle, and balanced ambiguous histories are included.

All six mechanisms receive the same arrived observations: marginal/present, recency, development-selected order-1–3 transition, absolute sequence retrieval, transformation-aware sequence retrieval, and a lightweight relational readout. Only development selects structural parameters; only four calibration groups fit probability parameters. A separate guarded predictor process receives strict arrival messages without evaluator metadata/futures. Forecasts are hash-chained, appended and fsynced before future reveal; same-prefix future substitutions must yield identical forecast bytes.

Frozen scoring: .35-semitone point tolerance; group-weighted accuracy and both-members paired success; log loss and distribution Brier; 5,000 paired group bootstrap resamples with seed 2026091907. Basic paired success >=.80 with positive lower95 improvement over present and passing controls; transfer paired success >=.70. A requires >=.10 transfer advantage over strongest simpler baseline, positive lower95 paired bound and no worse proper scores. B requires passing basic plus the accuracy-difference CI wholly within ±.05 (and comparable proper scores), or a clearly superior simpler baseline. Ambiguity requires >=.90 mass on the predefined alternatives, <=.10 error per .5 alternative and max class probability <=.60. Invalid localized prerequisites select C; otherwise inconclusive. No tuning or second evaluation after held-out exposure.

All Experiment 08 and prior audit artifacts remain frozen. The estimator-provenance audit remains deferred. One complete successor PR and branch-selection receipt will follow, then the worker stops awaiting review.
